text:
eva_sales: Heads-up — AuroraFin (enterprise fintech) wants a short 2-week POC starting next Mon. They need a Dedicated GPU pool: 4x H100s in us-east-1, private VPC (tenant isolation), and temporary API keys for integration work. Also asked for a quick committed-monthly price estimate if they convert. Can infra/provisioning spin this up? :pray:

sam_se: Quick numbers check: what's their target concurrency / sustained qps / latency SLO? helps size queues and throttles.

eva_sales: They said ~50 concurrent sessions, bursts to ~110-130 qps on short prompts (~512 tokens). Target p50 generation latency under 100ms during business hours.

juan_infra: 4x H100 Dedicated pool should be a good start for those short prompts. With conservative runtime settings we should hit 80-140 qps depending on batching. We'll want throttles for burst shaping and a health probe to avoid queue bloat.

juan_infra: We need these to start provisioning:
- tenant org id
- VPC CIDR and any reserved ranges
- allowed outbound ports/FQDNs
- preferred AZs/subnets
- networking POC contact

eva_sales: Provided initial details:
org id: aurorafin-1324
VPC CIDR: 10.40.0.0/16 (they want no public internet egress)
Allowed outbound: 443 to Redwood control plane FQDNs, 22 to ops jumpbox only
AZs: us-east-1a, us-east-1b
POC: lucy@aurorafin.com

mike_prodops: For private VPC + Dedicated we do VPC peering with our control plane. If they prohibit public egress entirely, we must proxy control-plane calls via our egress NAT — confirm if that's acceptable. Also need a signed network attestation listing allowed outbound endpoints. Typical lead time: 48-96h after ticket + quota approval.

provision-bot: New RDW ticket RDW-83401 created. Provisioning ETA: 72h (pending quota/network sign-off). Owner: @juan_infra.

sam_se: Two product options to surface to customer:
1) Cost fallback: mixed pool option (3x H100 + 1x A100) to lower monthly committed cost while keeping most perf on H100s.
2) Runtime tuning for latency: lock model variant (quantized small), cap batch size, enable KV cache for short prompt locality.

sam_se: Suggested runtime snippet to paste into the POC deployment:
```
instances: 4
sku: H100
batching.max_tokens: 256
batching.max_requests: 8
model.variant: quantized-low-latency
kv_cache: on
```

eva_sales: They also want temporary API keys for connectors and local integration tests. Can we issue keys scoped to the Dedicated pool with TTL ~14 days?

mike_prodops: Yes — we can issue scoped API keys with expiry. Ops needs the requested scope and the user/email for audit. For dedicated pools we recommend service accounts + key rotation policy (we'll set TTL 14 days for POC).

juan_infra: On strict no-egress: confirm that allowing only control-plane FQDNs + our ops jumpbox is fine. If so, we'll provision peering and update route tables. Please upload CIDR + any certs/PSKs to RDW-83401 (encrypted).

eva_sales: Uploading now to RDW-83401 (secure). Asked AuroraFin whether mixed-pool fallback is acceptable; they are checking. Also requested signed attestation.

provision-bot: RDW-83401 updated (network doc attached). Next status update planned in ~24h.

mike_prodops: Pricing note — rough ballpark for a 4xH100 reserved Dedicated pool (monthly committed): expect ~20-30% discount vs on-demand/hosted list, depending on term (12mo vs 36mo). Finance will drop a one-pager into the ticket with exact numbers.

eva_sales: Great — I'll keep AuroraFin posted and will notify this thread when they approve mixed-pool option and return the attestation. Thanks team :thumbsup:
